subject: Silver Shield
text: The Silver Shield can be purchased in Cantlin at the shop where the Flame Sword is sold, and trades in the Large Shield for 400-G.

evidence.quote: After finally getting the needed Gold, head back to Cantlin (running and healing, of course) and enter the place that you bought the Flame Sword. This should use up the last of your Keys. Buy the Silver Shield, and you will recieve 400-G for the Large Shield trade-in.

subject: Repel
text: Reaching Level 15 teaches the hero the Repel spell, which works like Fairy Water.

evidence.quote: Level 15 will be even better than 16, and you get a spell: Repel. This works like Fairy Water.

subject: Axe Knight
text: An Axe Knight guards the tree behind the shop in Hauksness where Erdrick's Armor is buried.

evidence.quote: Walk across the two swamp spaces, heal yourself fully no matter how many magic points it takes, and walk to the tree. Here you will find... an Axe Knight!

subject: Erdrick's Armor
text: Searching the area by the tree behind the shop in Hauksness after defeating the Axe Knight yields Erdrick's Armor.

evidence.quote: Search the area, and you will find the much sought-after Erdrick's Armor.

subject: Erdrick's Armor
text: Erdrick's Armor provides higher defense power, heals four times faster while walking, and grants invulnerability to swamps and barriers.

evidence.quote: This is better than the Magic Armor in three ways: It has a higher defense power; It heals you four times as fast while you're walking; and It makes you invulnerable to swamps and barriers!

subject: Erdrick's Token
text: Searching the large swamp south of Cantlin at the coordinates 70 south and 40 east of Tantegel yields Erdrick's Token.

evidence.quote: You will notice that we are pretty close to 70 south and 40 east of Tantegel (you heard those numbers in Cantlin, remember?). Use Gwaelin's Love to get to that certain spot, and search. Ta-da! Erdrick's Token.

subject: Rainbow Drop
text: The man in the cave south of Rimuldar exchanges the Staff of Rain and the Stones of Sunlight for the Rainbow Drop.

evidence.quote: Go past the town and go south to that cave with the rude guy in it. He will take the Staff of Rain and the Stones of Suntlight and give you the Rainbow Drop, the last piece of the Rainbow Puzzle.

subject: Rainbow Bridge
text: Using the Rainbow Drop on the peninsula west of Rimuldar creates the bridge leading across to Charlock Castle.

evidence.quote: Now, go north, past Rimuldar, and then west. You will find a little peninsula that looks like the perfect place for a bridge. Guess what? It is! Use the Rainbow Drop, and a bridge will miraculously appear before you. Go across, and follow the path to Charlock.

subject: Secret Passage
text: Searching behind the empty throne in Charlock Castle reveals a secret staircase leading down.

evidence.quote: Soon, you will be at the empty throne. Go behind it, and search the area. You will find a Secret Passage. Go down, and use Radiant.

subject: Erdrick's Sword
text: Taking the northwest path down the stairs, heading north and east, taking the stairs up twice, and following the path down leads to the chest containing Erdrick's Sword.

evidence.quote: Take the north-west road, and go down the stairs. In this new room, go north, then east. Pass that stairway leading down, and go south (to the west of the wall). Go up the stairway. Follow the path and go up the stairs at the end. Go up the next stairs. Follow the path, and go down the stairway. Finally, the chest! Open it up, and breathe a sigh of relief; it is in fact Erdrick's Sword.

subject: Starwyvern
text: Starwyverns should be countered with Sleep or Stopspell to prevent them from casting Healmore to restore up to 100 Hit Points.

evidence.quote: On Starwyverns, you should either use Sleep or Stopspell, because they love to draw the fight out by casting Healmore (heals up to 100 Hit Points!).

subject: Healmore
text: Reaching Level 17 unlocks the Healmore spell, which can restore up to 100 Hit Points.

evidence.quote: Level 17 really sucks, escept for the Healmore spell. This can heal up to 100 Hit Points, conveniently enough your maximum right now.

subject: Hurtmore
text: Reaching Level 19 unlocks the hero's final spell, Hurtmore.

evidence.quote: Finally, Level 19. Another big boost to your maximum Hit Points, and your last spell: Hurtmore.

subject: Dragonlord
text: If you agree to join the Dragonlord in his conquest when he asks, he kills you.

evidence.quote: He will ask you join him in his conquest of the world. Yeah, right. (If you said yes, he will babble about how you made the right choice, and then kill you.)

subject: Dragonlord
text: Magic does not work on the true Dragonlord form, so attack him directly and cast Healmore whenever Hit Points drop below 40 to defeat him and obtain the Ball of Light.

evidence.quote: Magic does not work on him, but you can still heal yourself. You should cast Healmore every time your Hit Points drop below 40; otherwise, attack him... When he does finally die, you will find the Ball of Light

subject: Ball of Light
text: Carrying the Ball of Light back through the Swamp Cave to Tantegel Castle completes the quest as King Lorik and the Princess celebrate the hero.

evidence.quote: Take the Ball of Light back to Tantegel Castle (yes, even though the game is essentially over, you still have to go through Swamp Cave just like anyone else). Once in the good castle, you will notice a celebration in progress... The King will tell you that you truly are in the line of Erdrick... Then, the Princess comes out and says that she wants to come with you.

subject: Charlock Castle B2 Enemies
text: Level 2 of Charlock Castle features the Blue Dragon and Stoneman, which both yield around 60 Experience Points.

evidence.quote: You have to be careful down here, though, because there are Axe Knights down here, along with two new baddies: the Blue Dragon and the Stoneman. Both are quite tough, but can get you around 60 Expirience Points.

subject: Magic Points
text: When grinding in Charlock Castle, keep Magic Points at 14 or above to ensure sufficient MP to cast Outside and Return.

evidence.quote: Also, never let your MP drop below 14; that is just enough to cast Outside and Return, to get you back to Tantegel and refuel your magic.
